name: attune
description: George Orwell's rules on writing well, injected at session start to govern every reply and every document the agent writes, plus two user-invoked skills for the questions a discussion turns on: explore drives the design conversation and brings the user only what only they can settle; experiment settles by blind comparison. On Claude Code, two more skills: review-doc reviews a document with one blind expert per section, and fix-issues applies what the review found, asking the user only for judgments.
